pages.text: Zhenyuan improves five attributes: Constitution gives +1 Max HP per point (Defense is now the standalone "Body Defense" attribute); Bone gives +1 Melee Damage and +1% Mining Speed; Agility gives +1% Move Speed and +0.2% Jump Height; Spell Power gives +5% base spell damage; Qi Sea gives +100 Max Qi and +1/sec Qi Recovery.
Most spell damage is not only its base value. It also scales with Spell Power, spirit roots, techniques, held weapons, passives, and other bonuses.
